dataset_title: GTFS Realtime Service Alerts - Metro Train and Yarra Trams

admission_evidence.native_record_key: feed mode + FeedEntity.id; each mode has a parent feed snapshot
admission_evidence.completeness_rule: Both advertised Metro Train and Yarra Trams Service Alerts FULL_DATASET protobuf feeds must parse; no partial mode publication

notes: Admission 2026-10-16: CC BY 4.0 per the landing page; the stored KeyID returned HTTP 200 for both feeds. Runs every 10 minutes, not every minute, because each publication rebuilds this source's geo_records_current rows (~0.5 GB billed); 2 requests a run. The static archive has no feed_info, so alerts match the newest published static schedule (matchRule latest_published_archive) instead of a publisher feed version; a stop alert is placed at its stop and a named-route alert is drawn along the routes' shapes. Public listing advertises Metro Train and Yarra Trams Service Alerts only; Bus has Trip Updates and Vehicle Positions, not a Service Alerts feed. Thus absent bus alerts never mean no bus disruption. KeyID must be provided by Secret Manager at deployment. FULL_DATASET disappearance is resolved using the latest successful snapshot per mode, not inferred as an explicit cancellation in this connector. NO_SERVICE describes service effect, not an alert tombstone. Static GTFS join must resolve route/stop IDs before assigning geometry.
